relationships.subject: N-sulfonylphenoxazines
relationships.evidence_quote: Noteworthy is the observation that the activity for compounds 4a, 4b and 10c is equivalent to the best so far recorded for this class of compound in this hCaV2.2 assay.

relationships.subject: N-sulfonylphenoxazines
relationships.evidence_quote: no strong inhibition was observed, with their measured IC50 values all falling in the 40–70 μM range

key_findings: Replacing the acyl link with sulfonyl gave 4-10 fold better CaV2.2 inhibition and much greater plasma stability.
Docking suggests ammonium tails bind the selectivity filter; CaV3.2 inhibition was weak (IC50 40-70 uM).
